name: dvstack
description: Skills and working examples for Playwright testing, front-end work an automated suite can drive, light agent-ops habits, and the system around coding agents, collected from real projects.

plugins.name: dvstack-frontend
plugins.description: Front-end skills that ship with working source files: markup an automated suite and an AI agent can actually drive, and a drop-in font switcher. The agent copies proven code into your project instead of rewriting it from scratch.

plugins.name: dvstack-testing
plugins.description: Playwright end-to-end skills: naming conventions, suite architecture, test strategy, step validation and waiting, fixtures, locators, auth and roles, test data, API-driven setup, network mocking, hard interactions, mobile and responsive, accessibility, visual testing, debugging, flaky-test triage, CI sharding, a code-review checklist, Playwright agents and MCP, and migrating off Cypress or Selenium. Slash commands force the whole pack or one skill.

plugins.name: dvstack-agents
plugins.description: Light-by-default agent habits for any coding tool: using-dvstack router, repo recon, quality bar, verify loop, session hygiene, when-to-deepen, trust stack, a thin dvstack-mode conductor, plus short anti-rationalization, doubt-check, and source-check skills. Slash commands force-load a skill. Orient, agree done, one honest verify, encode misses.

plugins.name: dvstack-harness
plugins.description: The system around coding agents: task contracts, tool gates, verify/recover, durable state, feature maps, hard CI, change receipts, plus execution-surface, tool-design, safeguard-parity, boundary-test, and risk-chain QA. Skip for short low-risk tasks.
